event_corrections.source: Banner reads only 'Mini T-SPIN' (no 'Single'), fr/g1/c035c.png. Score +300 at 3242.60 = zero-line Mini T-spin at level 3 (single is also 300 here, but the board top rows are unchanged before/after the T lock at 3242.4-3242.9, top1/top2 in c035c.png; a Mini TSS would be 600). The T is the piece spawned 3242.13; the 3242.63 piece locks at 3243.43 with drop points only (+34), no clear (fr/g1/c035b.png). No line was cleared by either.

Both players stall in 3249-3267 (pieces fall slowly, fr/g1/c035a.png). nextcount p1 spawns: 3248.77, 3259.77, 3267.73 (no spawn near 3257.53). Score p1 clears only at 3259.13 (+900, REN4, piece spawned 3248.77) and 3267.10 (+1050, REN5, piece spawned 3259.77). 3257.53 is a phantom.

No spawn at 3267.2 (nextcount p1: 3259.77 then 3267.73). The clear at 3267.10 is the 3259.77 piece; the next clear 3268.10 (+1200, REN6) is the 3267.73 piece. Score sequence 900,1050,1200,...,2400 (last at 3276.03, REN14) fits exactly one single per spawn from 3248.77 to 3275.6.

nextcount p2: spawns 3248.43, 3249.97, then 3268.80. Score p2: +900 at 3249.30 (REN4, 3248.43 piece), next clear +1050 at 3268.17 (REN5, 3249.97 piece, slow fall seen in fr/g1/c035a.png). 3250.07 is a duplicate of 3249.97.

No spawn at 3268.33 (nextcount p2: 3249.97 -> 3268.80). Score clears 3268.17 +1050 (REN5, 3249.97 piece) and 3268.97 +1200 (REN6, 3268.80 piece). With the two phantoms removed the predicted clear points (900,1050,1200,double 900,triple 1500,450,600,750) total 7350 vs observed 7468 incl. drop points.
Score p2 +750 at 3275.27 = single REN3 (after 450 at 3273.53, 600 at 3274.40); the piece spawned 3274.97 (nextcount) locks with a clear before the next spawn 3275.87; KO 3276.53.

Score p2 +1226 at 3866.57 = double (900) + REN2 (300) + 26 drop; a single REN2 would be 600. Z dropped at left at 3866.53 and the clear flash band spans two rows (fr/g1/c045.png), the lingering TETRIS banner covers the type banner. gc kept as chain's 1 (one colored row plus one garbage row).
nextcount p1 spawn (O) at 3975.70; it locks at 3975.97 (score +30, landed O visible, fr/g1/c047.png), before KO 3976.00 (やった at 3976.03). No clear.

Score p1 +750 at 4032.87 = single REN3 (after 300, 450, quad+REN2 2700); J into the well clears one colored row above the garbage with a '3 REN' banner (fr/g1/c048.png). Following singles 900..1800 then match the chain's seven singles.

Score p1 +5400 at 4317.83 = B2B TSD (3600x1.5); B2B TSS would be 3600. Banner 'T-SPIN Double' + BACK to BACK, flash spans the top colored row and one garbage row (fr/g1/c054.png). Next single +450 = REN1, consistent.
